DB21034E  The command was processed as an SQL statement because it was not a

SELECT VARCHAR(m.MODULENAME, 14) AS MODULENAME, m.OWNERTYPE AS MODULE_OWNERTYPE, r.ORIGIN, VARCHAR(r.OWNER, 10) AS ROUTINE_OWNER, r.OWNERTYPE AS ROUTINE_OWNERTYPE, COUNT(*) AS N FROM SYSCAT.ROUTINES r JOIN SYSCAT.MODULES m ON m.MODULEID = r.ROUTINEMODULEID WHERE m.MODULESCHEMA = 'SYSIBMADM' AND r.OWNERTYPE <> 'S' GROUP BY m.MODULENAME, m.OWNERTYPE, r.ORIGIN, r.OWNER, r.OWNERTYPE ORDER BY 1
